:::{#exm-conditional-as-or}
#### "If ..., then ..." as "or"
<!-- no-figure: a rewording of one sentence; nothing to plot -->

Let $n$ be an [integer](number-systems.qmd#def-integers).
By [a conditional without the arrow](#cor-conditional-as-or),
"if $n > 2$, then $n^2 > 4$"
says the same thing as
"$n \le 2$, or $n^2 > 4$".

:::
